messages.text: Hi, my friend Hugo asked me to sort out the refund for his speaker, order d07-o2. Can you refund it to my card?

Sorry, I can only help with orders placed by the signed-in customer, not your friend’s order. (refund-policy/v2/scope)

A refund also cannot be sent to another person’s card; it can only go to the order’s original payment. (refund-policy/v2/payment)
